sources.title: Ming-3.0-tts-tiny · Models
sources.snippet: This repository contains Ming-3.-tts-tiny, the Ming-3.0-tts mixture-of-experts checkpoint built on Ling V3. Its Ling V3 backbone has 7.9B total parameters and activates about 1.3B parameters per token. The repository includes sharded weights, supporting model code, audio tokenizer, speaker encoder and text tokenizer.
